newsitem.title: CANADA: Clearnet, Lucent in supply contract.
newsitem.headline: Clearnet, Lucent in supply contract.

text.p: Clearnet Communications Inc said on Friday that its wholly owned subsidiary Clearnet PCS Inc has entered into a C$475-million contract to purchase wireless equipment from Lucent Technologies Inc unit Lucent Technologies Canada Inc.

Under the agreement, Lucent wil provide personal communications services (PCS) infrastructure and subscriber equipment to Clearnet. The deal will be financed through Clearnet's access to a Lucent affiliate's credit facility.

"Lucent is a world-class leader in communications technologies and, as their Canadian PCS partner, Clearnet is eager to bring the benefits of their products and expertise to Canadian wireless users," said George Cope, Clearnet's president.

In a separate announcement, Clearnet said it would invest more than C$520 million on a capital expenditure program, including C$390 million on a plan to start up personal communications services in major urban areas.
Clearnet said it expects to hire an additional 400 employees in 1997 in its highest growth markets - Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto and Montreal.
